public_feedback.scope: Public request inputs only; no held-out verdict is supplied.

blocks.source_excerpt: void initialize(void) { a=b=c=d=k=l=r=bad=0; enabled=1; a=1; b=1; }
blocks.correspondence: This is the initialization block: it sets the modeled variables to their initial values, with a and b ultimately set to 1, enabled to 1, and the remaining variables to 0.
This is the interrupt handler; it assigns 2 to a and b.
This step calls gate() and stores its return value in k; gate captures enabled shifted left by 2, then clears enabled.
This step calls ungate(4), setting enabled according to whether 4 & 4 is nonzero.
This step copies a into c.
This step copies b into d.
This step calls ungate(k), setting enabled according to whether k & 4 is nonzero.
This step sets bad to 1 if c and d differ, otherwise 0.
